description: Check whether something a dog or cat ate is toxic (chocolate, xylitol, onion/garlic, macadamia, grapes/raisins, lilies, caffeine, alcohol), and — given the pet's weight and the amount eaten — the emergency level, using dose thresholds from the Merck Veterinary Manual. A substance not in the list is NOT confirmed safe. Triage aid, not a diagnosis.

amount_count.description: Amount eaten as a count of pieces (used when grams are unknown)

substance.description: What the pet ate, in Korean or English, e.g. 'dark chocolate', '포도', 'xylitol gum'

variant.description: Variant key or label if known (e.g. 'milk', 'dark', 'baking'); the response lists the variants

name: check_toxic_food
title: Toxic food check for dogs and cats
